set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend/operations engineer

Outcome: A clean institutional staging host can run a pinned Sanctity release without using sbt as the service manager.

Acceptance:
- Supply a versioned artifact/deployment manifest, validated configuration, TLS/origin and secret setup, process supervision and graceful shutdown.
- Separate migration privileges/command from runtime database access; retain drift checks and provide upgrade failure/restore procedures and compatibility checks for old releases.
- Rehearse clean installation and an upgrade from the existing schema with pinned sources/dependencies and retained results; do not claim hosted CI or deployment execution without receipts.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/app/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala
- build.sbt

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: O01: Package an installable service with controlled upgrades
